neighbours.label: news or tidings received: the word for information that arrives or is heard (good news, glad to hear, brought word, une nouvelle, la noticia)
fire: When she finally called, the nurse had some wonderful news for us.
We were all relieved to hear that the missing hiker was found.
A messenger arrived with tidings of the king's death.
I am sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but the shop is closing.
Tengo una buena noticia: mi hermana va a tener un bebé.
The villagers had received word that the bridge was washed away.
Ma mère m'a annoncé une grande nouvelle hier soir.
Have you heard the news about the new mayor?
quiet: When she finally called, the nurse had some wonderful soup for us.
We were all relieved to see that the missing hiker was smiling.
A messenger arrived with gifts for the king's daughter.
I am sorry to be the cause of this delay, but the shop is closing.
Tengo una buena bicicleta: mi hermana me la regaló.
The villagers had received food after the bridge was washed away.
Ma mère m'a préparé une grande tarte hier soir.
Have you met the wife of the new mayor?

notes: Card: ' news' x11 plus tidings, intelligence, hear, nouvelle, noticia. Probe: news 0.64, glad to hear 0.81, brought word 0.48, nouvelle 0.96; 'good results' 0.14, newspaper 0.09.
